patch_description: The previous SEARCH text did not exist in the file. The editable region contains a simple seeded-random point generator ending with three lines that create the RNG, draw points, and return them. I replace exactly those lines with a deterministic multi-start hill-climbing optimizer for the Heilbronn n=13 problem: it generates diverse candidate configurations (3-fold symmetric, ring, grid, random), refines each by coordinate-perturbation hill climbing on the objective "smallest triangle area / convex hull area" (vectorized over all C(13,3)=286 triangles), and returns the best point set. Fixed seed and deterministic perturbation order guarantee reproducibility. The function still returns an (n,2) numpy array so existing callers/metrics keep working.
